name: diff-ask
description: Ask questions about your workspace diff, anchored to exact lines: hover + to question a line, drag line numbers for ranges, free-form questions from the ask bar, one message with everything. Modes: working tree, unpushed, last turn, and a commit browser with hash/title search.

description_i18n.en: Live workspace diff panel with a '+' on every diff line: click it, write a question, and it reaches the conversation anchored to the exact file and line.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 实时工作区差异面板：每行差异都有“+”，点击后写下问题，问题会以精确的文件与行号发进对话。
